svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Every layer expanded: from the sources up to readiness
svg.text: Every layer expanded: from the sources up to readiness
Data flows up: source → raw → formatted → scoring → weighting → pillar → readiness. Layer names are working names.

g.text: the sum of every score's points
Red flags: scores that act on readiness directly
Illness check (temperature, breathing, resting HR, HRV):
live today, takes 10 or 25 points off readiness
Proposed caps: fever 40 · illness 60 · HRV crash 60 ·

svg.text: Purple cards = raw: the shapes a source can send for that formatted value, best first, and what we do to turn it into it.
The best raw input available wins for each night or minute (the input cascade). "Over sleep" = grouped by the sleep window.
Beat-to-beat = RR intervals from the strap, IBI from the ring. A new device only has to supply one of these raw inputs.
Source pills: filled = sends it today · dashed = planned (Oura API, ring beat-to-beat HRV) or possible (strap worn overnight, HC = Health Connect).
Each score shows its weighting: the points it can add to readiness. Red edge and red line = it can also act on readiness directly. Dashed = not built.
Working names, bottom to top: 1 source · 2 raw · 3 formatted · 4 scoring · 5 weighting · 6 pillar · 7 readiness.
